context._comment_optional: An empty string means unset. See README.
context._comment_amiId: PINNED ON PURPOSE. Resolving the latest AL2023 image on every deploy means an upstream refresh replaces the instance during an unrelated deploy, and CloudFormation creates the new volume attachment before deleting the old one, so that replacement fails with VolumeInUse and rolls back. Refresh deliberately: aws ssm get-parameter --name /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-6.1-x86_64 --query Parameter.Value --output text --region ap-south-1 (al2023-ami-2023.12.20261013.0-kernel-6.1-x86_64, ap-south-1).
context._comment_adminCidr: OPEN TO THE ENTIRE INTERNET at the operator's explicit request, so the dashboard is reachable from any address. The previous /32 went stale twice as the operator's residential IP moved, locking them out each time, and each refresh cost a pull request and a deploy. Understand the trade: port 2785 speaks plain HTTP, so the API key crosses the network in cleartext and whoever reads it can send WhatsApp messages as the linked account and read its history; anyone can also reach the login page and try keys. Narrow this to a /32 or remove it once the QR scan is done. The SSM port-forwarding tunnel gives the same access from any network with no ingress rule, and an HTTPS load balancer is the supported way to expose this permanently.
context._comment_peer: Private API access from WcsBackend (default VPC). Route table is that VPC's main table. Reach it at http://openwa.internal:2785 from inside either VPC.
context._comment_githubDeployRefs: This repository uses GitHub's immutable OIDC subject format (gh api repos/opex-labs-ai/OpenWA/actions/oidc/customization/sub), so the token's sub is repo:<owner>@<id>/<repo>@<id>:... The plain form is kept in case the repository setting is ever switched back.
